GalleryImage.title: GalleryImage
GalleryImage.description: A curated image published from the Admin Panel via ImgBB URL and synced to the User Panel gallery.

title.description: Display title of the image (1-120 characters).

description.description: Optional editorial caption or story behind the image (0-600 characters).

category.description: Collection category label such as Nature, Architecture, Abstract, Minimal, or Portraits.

imageUrl.description: Full-resolution HTTPS image URL (e.g. ImgBB display_url).

thumbUrl.description: Optional thumbnail HTTPS URL for fast grid loading.

featured.description: Whether the image is highlighted in the Featured Spotlight banner.

uploadedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who published the image.

tags.description: Bounded list of up to 10 discovery tags.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/gallery_images/{imageId}.description: Shared curated gallery images uploaded by admins and browsed in the User Panel without sign-up.
